name: GitHub
description: Work with GitHub issues, pull requests and Projects boards. Your token stays in AutoByteus.

token.help: Create a fine-grained token at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new, limited to the repositories your agents work on, with Issues, Pull requests and Contents read and write (and the organisation's Projects read and write for a board). A board owned by a personal account needs a classic token with the repo and project scopes.
